text: This case is a performance-tuning step for xs-rs’s no-op run on the congress-sample corpus, where xs-rs currently takes 1.502 seconds versus 0.974 seconds for the C++ version—about 1.54 times slower. Closing that gap matters because the lab wants xs-rs to match and then beat the original on speed, with rsync’s 1.582 seconds serving only as a reference. A second no-op measurement on real projects is still pending, so this is the active speed target.
